changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0028. Replace the per-tenant licensing model (TenantLicenses, FeatureFlags, PlanLimits, LicenseCapacityGrants, UserLicenseAssignments, LicenseOverrides) with an industry-standard subscription model: one Subscriptions table (a subscriber is a tenant or a user attached to a plan) and one SubscriptionSeats table (a paid seat on a subscription). Entitlements are computed live from the plan's features; there are no per-tenant feature copies or overrides. Index review: PK_Subscriptions on Id; UX_Subscriptions_TenantId enforces one active subscription per tenant (the entitlement lookup); IX_Subscriptions_UserId supports user subscriptions; IX_Subscriptions_ExpiresAt lists expiring subscriptions; PK_SubscriptionSeats on Id; IX_SubscriptionSeats_SubscriptionId_Status counts active seats; UX_SubscriptionSeats_Subscription_User stops a second active seat for the same person. Performance note: seat counts and entitlement checks filter by the parent key first, then a short status. Migration keeps each license Id as the subscription Id so assignments map onto seats by foreign key.
